description: Before an agent reads, cites, links to or pays a site: whether it is listed as malware or phishing (Google Safe Browsing, the Cloudflare security resolver, PhishTank), which list says so, where to check it and where its owner requests a review, plus HSTS preload and the hacked-site signatures from its latest CrawlCheck scan. An unread list is reported as unread, never as clean. Free.
name: check_site_safety
